# Unknowns and risks

Three questions hold up the requirements for recording a delivery: [[#UNK-001 Extra charges and the invoice|how extra charges at a stop reach the invoice]], [[#UNK-002 The language of the app in Quebec|which language the app must be in for the Quebec drivers]], and [[#UNK-003 The app while the truck moves|what the app may do while the truck moves]]. Each is with Dispatch. No risks are recorded yet.

## Unknowns

### UNK-001 Extra charges and the invoice

Drivers record extra charges at a stop on paper today, and Billing adds them by hand. Nobody knows how a charge recorded in the app reaches the invoice.

- **Question:** How does an extra charge recorded at the stop reach the customer's invoice?
- **Owner:** @dispatch
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[CAP-001-record-a-delivery#CAP-001.FR9 Extra charges at the stop|extra charges at the stop]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-30
- **Opened:** 2026-10-12

### UNK-002 The language of the app in Quebec

Part of the workforce is in Quebec. Nobody knows which language the app must be in for them, or whether the vendor can provide it.

- **Question:** Which language must the Quebec drivers' app be in, and can the vendor provide it by go-live?
- **Owner:** @dispatch
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[CAP-001-record-a-delivery#CAP-001.FR10 The app's language|the app's language]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-30
- **Opened:** 2026-10-12

### UNK-003 The app while the truck moves

The delivery form would open on arrival, possibly before the truck has stopped. Nobody has checked what the driving rules allow.

- **Question:** What may the app show or ask of a driver while the truck is still moving?
- **Owner:** @dispatch
- **State:** open
- **Blocks:** [[CAP-001-record-a-delivery#CAP-001.FR11 When the delivery form opens|when the delivery form opens]]
- **Ask by:** 2026-10-30
- **Opened:** 2026-10-12
